description: Source code for a BatchWorker class managing batch jobs in Mattermost, including job execution, control, and error handling.

classes.name: BatchWorker
classes.description: A worker that processes batch jobs, manages job lifecycle, and handles concurrency control.

methods.name: MakeBatchWorker
methods.description: Factory function to create a new BatchWorker with specified parameters.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the worker in a separate goroutine, processing jobs until stopped.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Signals the worker to stop processing jobs.

methods.name: JobChannel
methods.description: Returns the channel through which jobs are received.

methods.name: IsEnabled
methods.description: Indicates that batch jobs are always enabled.

methods.name: DoJob
methods.description: Executes a given job, including claiming, processing, and error handling.

methods.name: resetJob
methods.description: Resets job data and marks it as pending for re-queuing.

methods.name: setJobSuccess
methods.description: Marks a job as successfully completed.

methods.name: setJobError
methods.description: Marks a job as errored, preventing re-execution.
